schema: Every numeric leaf has C/P classification and source_script; all empirical results here are P.

ab_pell_raw.json.failed_attempt_note: First large-cell complex inertia bracket failed its imaginary-pivot check. No value retained. Replaced by own full-FE positive-K generalized eigensolve. Failed attempt CPU is accounted separately.

ab_window_raw.json.definition: Primary excess = positive normalized facet violation, matching main. Euclidean and recentered controls also saved.

small_density_polynomial.definition: Mean relative pressure loss = a*moved + b*moved^2, zero intercept; descriptive local fit.

disorder.note: Pointwise mean CIs and exponent CIs resample entire seed trajectories; accepted-flip trajectories are not equilibrium draws.

window_vs_moved_rank_advantage.definition: rho(moved,pressure) minus rho(excess,pressure); positive means stronger negative association for window excess.

severity_stratified_permutation.interpretation: Tests additional within-severity association; pooled trend survives even under this null.

ab_reference_raw.json.note: 47,321-vertex angular midpoint. A finite approximant reference, not an exact irrational QC value.

ab_run_audit.json.note: The last process CPU observation preceded failure; 1200 s is an accounting allowance, not a measured total. Auxiliary scripts/analysis are allowed another 300 s. The failed run was rejected for a nonreal Hermitian LU pivot, and supplied no large-cell result.
